groups.title: Colours of the rainbow
groups.explanation: The rainbow is traditionally described with seven colours, from red to violet. Orange is a fruit too, but the citrus group already has four.

groups.title: Citrus fruits
groups.explanation: Lime is also a shade of green, but it is not one of the rainbow colours.

groups.title: Hidden animals
groups.explanation: sCATter, PIGment, CROWd, sCOWl. GrAPEfruit hides an animal too, but it belongs with the citrus fruits.
